name: com.kidzdev.unity.localization
description: Lightweight localization system with UniTask async loading. Supports JSON and ScriptableObject data sources, plug-in custom loaders, and auto-refreshing TMP_Text components.

samples.description: Walks through the full setup workflow: Configure() from a LocalizationSettings asset, SetLanguage sync and async, GetText lookup, and Release. Includes JSON mock data for English and Thai.
